headline: Movement Log, from entry to detail
overview: Log movement type, duration, intensity, and how it felt to build a mindful relationship with physical activity and track your movement patterns.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Log movement type and specific activity
Capture how the movement felt — physically and emotionally
Track movement patterns and build a mindful activity practice
tips: Include all types of movement — walks, stretching, and dancing count alongside workouts.
The 'how it felt' field is especially valuable: notice correlations between movement type and mood.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
